# Jaktra

> AI-native accounts receivable automation platform that automates multi-channel B2B collections with intelligent 5-stage tone escalation, dispute triage, and self-service installment payment plans.

## Core Pages

- [Overview](https://jaktra.site/): Main product landing page featuring accounts receivable automation, platform capabilities, interactive demo, and security architecture.
- [Documentation](https://jaktra.site/docs): Developer documentation, API setup guides, webhook integration specifications, and payment gateway configuration.
- [Privacy Policy](https://jaktra.site/privacy): Detailed information on data isolation, tenant security, AES-256 encryption, and GDPR compliance.
- [Terms of Service](https://jaktra.site/terms): Complete legal terms governing accounts, subscriptions, usage limits, and liability.

## Capabilities & Architecture

- [5-Stage AI Tone Escalation](https://jaktra.site/#features): Intelligent collection cadences transitioning from warm friendly reminders to formal legal hold.
- [Dispute Triage Engine](https://jaktra.site/#features): Automated categorization of debtor replies with AI-generated draft responses for team review.
- [Debtor Payment Portal](https://jaktra.site/#features): Tokenized self-service portal for debtors to view invoices, execute Razorpay payments, or request payment plans.
- [Security & Tenant Isolation](https://jaktra.site/#security): Strict multi-tenant data isolation, AES-256 encryption at rest, and audit trail logging.

## Optional

- [XML Sitemap](https://jaktra.site/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all public canonical pages.
- [Robots Rules](https://jaktra.site/robots.txt): Crawler indexing permissions and disallowed authenticated portals.
